_readme: Basia’s complete Rapaport tree, exported from Ahnenblatt as GEDCOM 5.5.1 on 5 August 2026 and converted here. 1,442 people. THIS IS THE EXTENDED LAYER, NOT THE CORE: people.json holds the 179 people this archive has researched itself, with facts, photographs and confidence levels. Where a person appears in both, "core_id" points at ours and the site shows ours. Everything here is sourced to Basia and should be described as such.

focus.note: steps_from_family is the number of parent/child/spouse hops from David, Lusia, Shimon or Dov. 0 is one of them. The tree opens on the low numbers and expands outward.
